title: Truncation removes a required value from tainted evidence
claim: A tainted SQL evidence part starting after the 250-character truncation budget serializes with source and truncated but without the value required by the shared IAST schema.
repro_command: cp .omo/review/evidence/sink-parity/schema_parity_test.go /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-parity/internal/taint/redaction/schema_parity_test.go && cd /tmp/ddiast-review/wt/sink-parity && GOFLAGS=-p=4 GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -timeout 5m -run '^TestTaintedPartAtTruncationBoundaryHasRequiredValue$' -count=1 -v ./internal/taint/redaction

title: Schema test skips the normal Go meta-struct payload
claim: The schema test only validates _dd.iast.json, while Go normally emits iast under meta_struct, so it skips Go reports on the normal path.
